response.rationale: The positive string test (F06) and multifocal infections (F08-F12) with a large liver abscess (F10) strongly indicate invasive Klebsiella pneumoniae syndrome. The absence of cirrhosis (F13) does not exclude this, as it is not required. Newly diagnosed diabetes (F04) and alcohol use (F03) are classic risk factors. D1 is the most complete and specific diagnosis, while D2 is a close second focusing on the liver abscess as the primary source.
